map.Q = m·c·ΔT；水的比热容约 4186 J/(kg·K)。: Q = m c DeltaT; water specific heat is about 4186 J/(kg K).
map.1 kg 水升温 10℃ 需 41.86 kJ。: Raising 1 kg water by 10C needs 41.86 kJ.
map.物体升温/降温显热 Q=mcΔT。: Sensible heat for heating/cooling an object Q=mc DeltaT.
map.与潜热叠加得总热。: Add with latent heat for the total heat.
map.c=460（钢）：同条件 Q=4.6 kJ，升温快得多。: c=460 (steel): under the same conditions Q=4.6 kJ, heating much faster.
map.同物质液/固/气 c 不同，相变区用潜热而非比热。: For the same substance liquid/solid/gas have different c; in the phase-change region use latent heat rather than specific heat.
map.大温跨时 c 略变，精确计算用积分或平均比热。: Over a large temperature span c varies slightly; for accurate calculation use integration or mean specific heat.
